exact_statement: For every integer m>=3, let g_m=Maj_3^{tensor m}, h_m=Q_3^{tensor m}, and F_m(y,x)=g_m(x) for y=+1 and h_m(x) for y=-1. Then G(F_m)<=36 I(F_m), with I(F_m)=9m/8+(1-(-1/4)^m)/2. More strongly, E_m=U(F_m)-(U(g_m)+U(h_m))/2 satisfies |E_m-m/4|<=187/32, and each physical-child remainder E_{i,±} satisfies |E_{i,±}-(m-1)/4|<=187/32.
